series_start_reason: Genzyme Corporation (CIK 0000732485), the owner before Sanofi consolidated Genzyme on April 1, 2011, printed the line in its own Forms 10-Q and earnings releases, in USD; those quarters are joined to Sanofi's EUR quarters from 2011Q2 (currency recorded per row). The series starts at 1999Q1. 1999Q3 onward is a table row of the Form 10-Q (accession 0000950135-99-005293, 'Sales of Cerezyme enzyme and Ceredase enzyme ... $121,058 $105,485 ... $351,716 $297,609'); 1999Q1 and 1999Q2 are read from the prior-year columns of the 2000 Forms 10-Q because the 1999 Forms 10-Q print the combined figure only as rounded text. 1999Q1-2002Q2 is the combined 'Cerezyme and Ceredase' line; the Q3 1999 Form 10-Q says virtually all Gaucher patients had been converted from Ceredase to Cerezyme, and Genzyme relabels the row 'Cerezyme' from the Q3 2002 Form 10-Q with identical prior-year values (143,048 in both the Q3 2001 and Q3 2002 Forms 10-Q). Earlier quarters are excluded: for 1997Q1-1998Q4 the combined line still included material Ceredase sales (Cerezyme was 83% of the combined revenues in 1998Q2 and 86% in 1998Q3 per the Forms 10-Q), so it overstates Cerezyme and is not the same scope as the series from 1999Q1. Those combined-line figures (1997Q1 76.4, 1997Q2 80.3, 1997Q3 85.6, 1998Q1 93.5, 1998Q2 98.6, 1998Q3 105.485) are rounded prose or comparative-column figures and are not carried as rows. Before 1997 the filings print the combined line in dollars only for the first quarter of 1995 and 1996 and for full years; the Forms 10-Q for the second and third quarters of 1996 give only a percentage of product sales.
moa: Recombinant analogue of human beta-glucocerebrosidase enzyme replacement therapy

approval_evidence.quote: CEREZYME (imiglucerase) for injection, for intravenous use ... Initial U.S. Approval: 1994

notes: Scope: worldwide net sales as the issuer prints them: EUR for Sanofi (2011Q2 on), USD thousands for Genzyme Corporation (1999Q1-2010Q4); the Genzyme table carries no territory restriction and the Genzyme Forms 10-K describe Cerezyme as distributed in 60 to 80 countries. The headline Net sales table carries one worldwide figure per product; where the release also prints the appendix table of net sales by region, its Total Sales column repeats the same figure (Q1 2024: 214 in both). A search for statements of a territory or formulation joining the Cerezyme line was not made beyond reading the table rows. Launch quarter is null: the product launched in the U.S. in 1994 (label 'Initial U.S. Approval: 1994'), long before Sanofi's series. 2011 quarters carry the Genzyme table 'Net sales since April 1st 2011'; the three printed 2011 quarters (166, 141, 133) differ by 1 from the 441 printed as the Q4 2011 'net sales since April 1st' total, a rounding difference between printed figures. 2012Q2: the release prints the header 'Q2 2011 net sales' over Q2 2012 figures; Q1 2012 (149) plus Q2 2012 (150) equals the printed H1 2012 figure 299. Genzyme rows 1999Q1-2002Q2 are the combined 'Cerezyme and Ceredase enzymes' line, which Genzyme itself carries on as 'Cerezyme enzyme' from the Q3 2002 Form 10-Q with identical figures; the Q3 1999 Form 10-Q says virtually all Gaucher patients had been converted from Ceredase to Cerezyme. Fourth quarters 2004-2010 are the last quarterly column of the Cerezyme row in Genzyme's fourth-quarter earnings releases (Forms 8-K); fourth quarters 1999-2002 are the annual figure less the nine-month figure (annual_less_reported_first_nine_months) because Genzyme filed no earlier fourth-quarter release row in this series; the fourth quarter of 2003 is the Q4-03 column of the February 17, 2005 release (direct_retrospective_table), 192,683, which also equals the Form 10-K annual 733,817 less nine months 541,134 (the February 19, 2004 release printed 197,747 for the quarter, later revised). The four quarters of every year 1999-2010 sum to the annual figure printed by Genzyme. The 1997Q1-1998Q4 combined-line quarters are not carried because the Ceredase share there was material (see series_start_reason); 1999Q1-2002Q2 is accepted as the Cerezyme line on the strength of the Q3 1999 Form 10-Q conversion statement and the identical values under the 'Cerezyme' label from Q3 2002. Quarterly figures for 1996 and earlier: see series_start_reason.
search_log: reused the list of Sanofi (CIK 0001121404) quarterly-results releases 2011Q2-2026Q2 (one exhibit per quarter, 61 releases) already established for sanofi_fabrazyme (urls from seed/gold/source_manifests/sanofi_fabrazyme_quarterly.csv), re-fetched every one of the 61 from sec.gov Archives and parsed every table row (bs4) whose first cell starts with the product name

for each release took the product's row from the first table headed 'Net sales (€ million)' (worldwide, one row per product; 2011-2015 headers read '(millions of euros) / Q2 2011 net sales' or '€ million'), quarter figure first, then the H1 / 9M / FY / YTD column where printed; where a product has no row in that table (see below) used the Total Sales column of the appendix table of net sales by region

checked for every full year in which all four quarters are in the series that the four quarters equal the full-year figure printed in the Q4 release; all matched exactly (see notes where the series starts or ends mid-year)
Bigdata.com was not used; the releases were located from the existing Sanofi manifest and read directly
Cerezyme row present in the headline Net sales table of every release 2011Q2-2026Q2 (61 of 61); no gaps; no release prints a different label than 'Cerezyme' (with or without the registered mark)
FDA: Drugs@FDA BLA 020367 label 2024 (s122) prints 'Initial U.S. Approval: 1994'

Extension: listed Genzyme Corporation (CIK 0000732485) filings via data.sec.gov submissions (recent plus older file): 1995-2011 Forms 10-Q, 10-K, 10-K405 and amendments, and the 8-Ks with earnings releases (items 12 and 2.02, 2004-2011); downloaded every 10-Q and 10-K and read each Cerezyme row

Genzyme 10-Q product rows read for 1999Q3-2010Q3 (Forms 10-Q); 10-Q/A filings of 2000-10-17, 2009-09-04, 2010-05-11 and 2010-09-07 were not used (the originals are cited); 2001Q2 is read from the prior-year column of the Q2 2002 Form 10-Q because the Q2 2001 table wraps its label over four lines

Fourth quarters: earnings releases (Forms 8-K) of 2005-02-17, 2006-02-15, 2007-02-14, 2008-02-13, 2009-02-11, 2010-02-17 and 2011-02-16 for 2004-2010; Forms 10-K (Exhibit 13) for 1999-2003 annual figures; sums of the four quarters checked against each year
2011Q1: no Genzyme Form 10-Q or earnings release exists after the 2011-02-16 release (EDGAR list ends with the merger 8-K of 2011-04-08 and Form 15 of 2011-04-18)

Pre-1999 (re-opened): re-read every Genzyme Form 10-Q and 10-K for 1995-1999 (accessions listed under CIK 732485, including 10-K/A and 10-Q/A filings; local copies of the .txt files). Found combined Cerezyme and Ceredase dollar figures in text: Q1 1995 49.4 and Q1 1996 58.8 (Q1 1996 10-Q), Q1 1997 76.4 (Q1 1997 10-Q), Q2 1997 80.3 and six months 156.7 and Q2 1998 98.6 and six months 192.1 (Q2 1998 10-Q), Q3 1997 85.6 and nine months 242.3 and Q3 1998 105.5 and nine months 297.6 (Q3 1998 10-Q), Q1 1998 93.5 (Q1 1999 10-Q); table figures 105,485 and 297,609 for 1998Q3 and nine months 1998 (Q3 1999 10-Q) and 411,060 for 1998 and 332,712 for 1997 (Form 10-K for 1999). The Forms 10-Q for Q2 1997, Q3 1997 and Q1 1998 give the line only as a percentage, a growth rate or the Therapeutics business-unit total, so those quarters are read from the following year's comparative sentences.

1996 and earlier: Forms 10-Q for Q2 1996 and Q3 1996 print Ceredase and Cerezyme sales only as a percentage of product sales (71% and 67%; 59% and 64%) and the Form 10-K for 1996 gives the year ($264.6 million, segment table 264,588); no dollar figure for 1996Q2, 1996Q3 or 1996Q4 and no nine-month 1996 figure, so the quarters were not derived. Forms 8-K of 1996-02-23, 1997-02-04, 1998-01-08 and 1998-05-20 were opened and carry no Cerezyme or Ceredase sales figure.

Repair (scope): rows 1997Q1-1998Q4 dropped; series now starts 1999Q1. The 83% (Q2 1998) and 86% (Q3 1998) Cerezyme shares are as recorded in the earlier staged notes; the 86% was not re-read in this repair. 2003Q4 re-sourced to the Q4-03 column of the 2005-02-17 release (same line as the 2004Q4 row).

unreported_quarters.2011Q1: Ownership change Genzyme to Sanofi; no full-quarter figure is published. Genzyme's last periodic report is the Form 10-K for 2010 (filed 2011-03-01, amended 2011-03-24); it filed no Form 10-Q or earnings release for the quarter ended March 31, 2011 (Form 8-K of 2011-04-08 reports completion of the merger and a Form 15 followed on 2011-04-18). Sanofi consolidated Genzyme from April 1, 2011, and its Q2 2011 release is the first to print Genzyme net sales ('Net sales since April 1st 2011').

reviewed_anomalies.2011Q2: Issuer and currency step: 2010Q4 and earlier are Genzyme Corporation's USD figures, 2011Q2 on are Sanofi's EUR figures; values are not converted, and 2011Q1 is not published (see unreported_quarters).
reviewed_anomalies.2009Q3: Read at source: the Q3 2009 Form 10-Q prints Cerezyme 93,599 against 309,280 a year earlier, and its forward-looking statements refer to the financial impact of the production interruption at the Allston manufacturing facility and the timing of shipping new Cerezyme production. Kept as printed; the six-month and nine-month columns beside it (594,057 and 687,656) are consistent with the quarter.
reviewed_anomalies.2010Q1: Read at source: the Q1 2010 Form 10-Q prints Cerezyme 179,147 against 295,970 a year earlier and attributes lower product sales to 'decreased sales volumes for Cerezyme and Fabrazyme as a result of the supply constraints'. Kept as printed.
reviewed_anomalies.2002Q3: Label change, not a scope change: through 2002Q2 the line is printed 'Cerezyme/Ceredase enzymes' (and earlier 'Cerezyme and Ceredase enzymes') and from the Q3 2002 Form 10-Q 'Cerezyme enzyme'. The figures are continuous: the Q3 2002 Form 10-Q prints 143,048 for the third quarter of 2001, equal to the 143,048 in the Q3 2001 Form 10-Q, and the Q1 and Q2 2003 Forms 10-Q print 148,066 and 154,717 for the 2002 quarters, equal to the 2002 Forms 10-Q.
